business_problem: G-Town was scaling an AI-driven digital platform used for customer-lifecycle experience and supply-chain decision support, but the older ECS-based architecture wasted resources, could not react quickly enough to short traffic surges, and required manual, error-prone deployments. The company also lacked consistent observability and needed a safer release model for continuously changing business services.
solution_summary: G-Town rebuilt the runtime for its AI digital platform on Alibaba Cloud around Serverless Application Engine (SAE) and the cloud-native API gateway so services could scale and release faster without heavy infrastructure management. Business services are deployed to SAE, where load-driven scaling handles short peaks and can shrink idle workloads to one instance, while CPU Burst and Dragonwell JDK reduce Java startup overhead. The CI/CD pipeline was refactored around kubectl-sae, YAML-defined service specs, and one-click deployments so packaging, upload, rollback, and gray rollout could be automated instead of managed node by node. In front of those services, the MSE gateway provides routing, security controls, rate limiting, and gray-release policy management, while monitoring and log services improve diagnosis. The result is a serverless application platform that underpins G-Town's machine-learning-driven digital services while reducing operational drag.

solution_components.name: Serverless Application Engine (SAE)
solution_components.role: Runs G-Town's AI-platform application services with automatic scaling, release controls, and high-availability support.

solution_components.name: Cloud-native API Gateway (MSE Gateway)
solution_components.role: Handles routing, security policy, and gray-release traffic management in front of the platform services.

solution_components.name: Application Real-Time Monitoring Service
solution_components.role: Provides integrated runtime visibility so the team can identify faults and performance issues quickly.

solution_components.name: Log Service
solution_components.role: Centralizes operational logs that support troubleshooting and service analysis across the serverless environment.

data_flow: Business requests for G-Town's AI digital platform enter through the MSE gateway, which applies routing and traffic policies before sending them to SAE-hosted application services. SAE scales those services according to load, while monitoring signals and logs flow into Alibaba Cloud observability services so releases, incidents, and high-traffic events can be diagnosed and tuned more quickly.
business_outcome: G-Town completed a full architecture upgrade in two months and gave its AI digital platform a more elastic and controllable runtime. Resource utilization rose, idle spend fell, releases sped up from hours to minutes, and the team improved stability for bursty business events. The serverless stack also made it easier to keep iterating on digital services tied to customer-lifecycle optimization and supply-chain decision support.
metrics: CPU utilization rose from below 20% to above 50%
application startup time improved by more than 30%
architecture_clues: SAE can shrink workloads to one instance during low-traffic periods and use CPU Burst during startup spikes.
kubectl-sae plus YAML-defined service specs is part of the production release path for JAR applications.
MSE gateway is used for routing, DDoS protection, rate limiting, and gray-release traffic control in front of business services.
The source describes the application platform in detail but does not disclose the internal model stack behind G-Town's AI services.
